tasks.title: Create src/hooks/use-scholarship-filters.ts (full hook + ScholarshipFiltersValue)
tasks.description:
Create the new module at src/hooks/use-scholarship-filters.ts. Exports `useScholarshipFilters` and a `ScholarshipFiltersValue` type. The hook owns URL hydration, filter state, derived data, reset rules, and tag-selection serialisation behind a small interface.

HOOK SIGNATURE:
```ts
useScholarshipFilters(args: {
  scholarships: Scholarship[]
  onFilterChangeWhileExpanded?: () => void
}): ScholarshipFiltersValue
```

Returned `ScholarshipFiltersValue` shape:
- Current state: `activeFilter: EducationLevelFilter`, `layout: GridLayout`, `searchQuery: string`, `sortBy: string`, `selectedTags: Tag[]`, `page: number`, `awardRange: [number, number]`.
- Derived: `levelCounts: Record<EducationLevelFilter, number>`, `hasActiveFilters: boolean`.
- Setters: `setActiveFilter`, `setLayout`, `setSearchQuery`, `setSortBy`, `setSelectedTags`, `setPage`, `setAwardRange`.
- Plus `clearAll(): void` — resets all filters to defaults (level=All, q="", sort=deadline, tags=[], awardRange=[AWARD_MIN, AWARD_MAX], page=1) and resets layout? NO — layout is a UI preference; clearAll does NOT reset layout. Reset everything else.

URL SCHEMA (Nuqs `useQueryState`):
- `page` — `parseAsInteger.withDefault(1)`.
- `q` — `parseAsString.withDefault("")`.
- `sort` — `parseAsString.withDefault("deadline")`.
- `level` — `parseAsString.withDefault("All")` (cast to EducationLevelFilter; PRD User Story 6 lifts level into URL state for bookmarkability).
- `tags` — comma-separated Tag list. Implement using `parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString).withDefault([])` then validate against `ALL_TAGS` from @/lib/eligibility on hydration: tags not in ALL_TAGS are silently dropped (stale-bookmark guard per PRD §Interaction with the eligibility classifier). Cast surviving array to Tag[].
- `min` — `parseAsInteger.withDefault(AWARD_MIN)` for awardRange[0].
- `max` — `parseAsInteger.withDefault(AWARD_MAX)` for awardRange[1].

CLIENT-ONLY STATE:
- `layout: GridLayout` — `useState<GridLayout>("grid")`. NOT in URL (it's a UI preference).

DERIVED:
- `levelCounts` — `useMemo` over `args.scholarships`. For each EDUCATION_LEVELS entry: count items whose `classification` includes that level (or all items if level === "All"). Move the existing memo from scholarship-filters.tsx lines 70–87 into the hook.
- `hasActiveFilters` — true when any of: activeFilter !== "All" || searchQuery !== "" || sortBy !== "deadline" || selectedTags.length > 0 || awardRange[0] !== AWARD_MIN || awardRange[1] !== AWARD_MAX. (Page is not user-set in the same sense; exclude.)

RESET RULES (encapsulated in setters):
- Setting `activeFilter`, `searchQuery`, `sortBy`, `selectedTags`, OR `awardRange` resets `page` to its default (`null` for Nuqs to drop the param).
- Each filter setter (the five above) calls `args.onFilterChangeWhileExpanded?.()` BEFORE applying the new state via `requestAnimationFrame`, preserving the existing close-modal-then-filter UX (current grid lines 136–150 pattern). The hook is unaware of the modal — the grid passes the close callback. Implementation: if `onFilterChangeWhileExpanded` is provided, call it, then use `requestAnimationFrame(() => { setterPair() })` to defer the actual state update. If not provided, set state immediately.
- `setPage` itself does NOT reset (it IS the page setter).
- `setLayout` does NOT reset page (layout change shouldn't paginate).
- `clearAll()` resets everything except layout.

TAG SERIALIZATION:
- On hydration: read URL `tags` (comma-separated string array), filter against ALL_TAGS, cast survivors to Tag[].
- On set: write Tag[] back as comma-separated string (Nuqs handles via parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString)).
- Use a `useMemo` for the validated/narrowed selectedTags so consumers receive a stable Tag[] reference.

IMPORTS NEEDED:
- `useState`, `useMemo`, `useCallback` from "react".
- `useQueryState`, `parseAsInteger`, `parseAsString`, `parseAsArrayOf` from "nuqs".
- `EDUCATION_LEVELS`, `type EducationLevelFilter`, `AWARD_MIN`, `AWARD_MAX`, `type Scholarship` from "@/data/scholarships".
- `ALL_TAGS`, `type Tag` from "@/lib/eligibility".
- `type GridLayout` from "@/components/scholarships/scholarship-filters".

ALSO export `type ScholarshipFiltersValue` for consumers (the type of the returned object).

DO NOT modify any consumer in this task — only the new file.
acceptance: useScholarshipFilters(args: { scholarships: Scholarship[]; onFilterChangeWhileExpanded?: () => void }): ScholarshipFiltersValue.

Returned value exposes activeFilter, layout, searchQuery, sortBy, selectedTags, page, awardRange (state); levelCounts, hasActiveFilters (derived); setActiveFilter, setLayout, setSearchQuery, setSortBy, setSelectedTags, setPage, setAwardRange, clearAll (setters).

URL schema: page (integer, default 1), q (string, default ""), sort (string, default "deadline"), level (EducationLevelFilter, default "All"), tags (comma-separated Tag[], default []), min/max (integers, defaulting to AWARD_MIN/AWARD_MAX).
layout (grid vs. list) remains client-only state — it is a UI preference, not a discoverable filter, and does not belong in shareable URLs.
Setting activeFilter, searchQuery, sortBy, or selectedTags resets page to its default. (Plus awardRange in this codebase since it filters too.)
When the optional onFilterChangeWhileExpanded callback is provided and a filter setter is called, the hook invokes it before applying the new state via a requestAnimationFrame boundary.
Validation: tags not in ALL_TAGS (e.g., from a stale bookmark after a taxonomy change) are silently dropped on hydration.
tasks.notes: tags/min/max URL setters use null sentinel when value equals default (extends the q/sort/level/page convention to the new params for consistent clean URLs). setSelectedTags casts Tag[] to string[] for the Nuqs setter (parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString) types as string[]) — safe since Tag extends string. clearAll writes null to all 7 URL setters directly with no rAF and no onFilterChangeWhileExpanded — callers using clearAll from inside an open expanded modal must close the modal themselves first.

tasks.title: Rewire grid + collapse filter component prop interfaces
tasks.description:
This task is the atomic switchover: scholarship-grid.tsx adopts the hook AND both filter components collapse their prop interfaces to { filters, resultCount, seasonalScholarships }. They must change together to keep typecheck green.

FILE 1: src/components/scholarships/scholarship-grid.tsx

DELETE these lines (current line numbers approximate):
- `useState` declarations for activeFilter (~53), layout (~55), eligibilityTags (~56), awardRange (~57). KEEP expandedId useState and previousFocusRef.
- `useQueryState` declarations for page (~61), searchQuery (~62), sortBy (~66). KEEP everything else.
- The currentSeason / nextSeason useMemo blocks STAY.
- The seasonalScholarships useMemo STAYS.
- The sortedItems useMemo STAYS but its filterAndSort call updates: replace `eligibilityTags as Tag[]` and `awardRange` with `filters.selectedTags` and `filters.awardRange`. Replace activeFilter, searchQuery, sortBy with their filters.* equivalents. Update the deps array.
- The totalPages / safePage / start / visibleItems block STAYS.
- The expandedScholarship line STAYS.
- The page-clamp useEffect (lines ~106–110) STAYS but reads `filters.page` and calls `filters.setPage`.
- DELETE: handleSearchChange (~113–119), handleSortChange (~121–127), handleFilterChange (~136–150), handleEligibilityTagsChange (~197–203), handleAwardRangeChange (~205–211), clearAllFilters (~213–220).
- The Lenis-resize useEffect (~130–134) STAYS but updates its deps array (drops the deleted handlers' state).
- goToPage useCallback STAYS (calls filters.setPage now).
- Modal-related code (handleExpand, handleClose, restorePreviousFocus, useScrollLock, the Escape useEffect) STAYS.
- The `Tag` import (T06 cascade bridge) — DELETE the `eligibilityTags as Tag[]` cast site (no longer needed) AND the `import type { Tag } from "@/lib/eligibility"` line at the top.

ADD: at the top of the component body (after expandedId useState), add `const filters = useScholarshipFilters({ scholarships: seasonalScholarships, onFilterChangeWhileExpanded: () => setExpandedId(null) })`. Note: seasonalScholarships is computed AFTER this — restructure so seasonalScholarships is computed first, THEN the hook call.

REPLACE the ScholarshipFilters JSX (~lines 238–254) with:
```jsx
<ScholarshipFilters
  filters={filters}
  resultCount={resultCount}
  seasonalScholarships={seasonalScholarships}
/>
```

REPLACE the ActiveFilterStrip JSX (~lines 257–267) — pull selectedTags/awardRange from filters: `selectedTags={filters.selectedTags}`, `onTagsChange={filters.setSelectedTags}`, `awardRange={filters.awardRange}`, `onAwardRangeChange={filters.setAwardRange}`. The ActiveFilterStrip prop signature itself is not changed in this task (T03 tightens its types).

REPLACE references in the empty-state Button (~line 305): `clearAllFilters` → `filters.clearAll`.

UPDATE references to local state: `activeFilter` → `filters.activeFilter`, `layout` → `filters.layout`, `searchQuery` → `filters.searchQuery`, `sortBy` → `filters.sortBy`, `eligibilityTags` → `filters.selectedTags`, `awardRange` → `filters.awardRange`, `page` → `filters.page`.

UPDATE the `isLevelEmpty` check, the layout switch (`layout === "grid"`), the empty-state condition, etc., to use filters.* where applicable.

FILE 2: src/components/scholarships/scholarship-filters.tsx

REPLACE the 14-property `ScholarshipFiltersProps` interface (lines ~29–45) with:
```ts
import type { ScholarshipFiltersValue } from "@/hooks/use-scholarship-filters"

interface ScholarshipFiltersProps {
  filters: ScholarshipFiltersValue
  resultCount: number
  seasonalScholarships: Scholarship[]
}
```

UPDATE the function signature destructuring (lines ~47–63) to `{ filters, resultCount, seasonalScholarships }`.

DELETE the local `levelCounts` useMemo (lines ~70–87). Use `filters.levelCounts` instead.

UPDATE the ScholarshipFiltersMobile call (lines ~94–110): pass `filters={filters} resultCount={resultCount} seasonalScholarships={seasonalScholarships}`.

UPDATE all internal references: `activeFilter` → `filters.activeFilter`, `onFilterChange` → `filters.setActiveFilter`, `layout` → `filters.layout`, etc. The setSortBy/setSearchQuery/etc. now come from filters.*.

UPDATE the FilterSheet JSX call (uses filters.selectedTags, filters.setSelectedTags, filters.awardRange, filters.setAwardRange, seasonalScholarships, and resultCount).

FILE 3: src/components/scholarships/scholarship-filters-mobile.tsx

REPLACE the 13-property `ScholarshipFiltersMobileProps` interface (lines ~39–53) with the same 3-property shape:
```ts
import type { ScholarshipFiltersValue } from "@/hooks/use-scholarship-filters"

interface ScholarshipFiltersMobileProps {
  filters: ScholarshipFiltersValue
  resultCount: number
  seasonalScholarships: Scholarship[]
}
```

UPDATE the function destructuring and ALL internal references following the same pattern as FILE 2.

GENERAL RULES FOR ALL THREE FILES:
- Default to no comments. Don't leave "// previously eligibilityTags" notes; just rename.
- Preserve all JSX structure, animations, classNames, accessibility attributes, conditional logic.
- Do NOT touch FilterSheet's internal implementation (T03 handles it).
- Do NOT touch ActiveFilterStrip's internal implementation (T03 handles it).
- The `as Tag[]` cast in scholarship-grid.tsx and the corresponding `import type { Tag } from "@/lib/eligibility"` import are deleted as part of this task — the hook returns Tag[] natively.
acceptance: scholarship-grid.tsx deletes its filter useState/useQueryState/useCallback block and instead does: const filters = useScholarshipFilters({ scholarships: seasonalScholarships, onFilterChangeWhileExpanded: () => setExpandedId(null) }).
Pagination math (PAGE_SIZE, safePage, getPageNumbers) stays in the grid because it is layout-specific. expandedId stays in the grid because it represents modal selection, not filter state.
scholarship-filters.tsx and scholarship-filters-mobile.tsx both reduce to: { filters: ScholarshipFiltersValue; resultCount: number; seasonalScholarships: Scholarship[] }.
levelCounts ceases to be a prop; both UIs read it from filters.
Existing user behaviour preserved: page resets when filter changes; modal closes before filter applies via requestAnimationFrame; level migration to URL is bookmarkable.
tasks.notes: Atomic switchover across 3 files. Page-clamp simplified to filters.setPage(safePage) — hook owns null sentinel. filteredCount prop dropped (FilterSheet receives resultCount directly). Mobile toggleTag casts string→Tag at the boundary. GOTCHA: hook's setSelectedTags is (tags: Tag[]) => void but FilterSheet/ActiveFilterStrip onTagsChange is still (tags: string[]) => void — bridge `as (tags: string[]) => void` casts at 2 call sites (grid ActiveFilterStrip, filters FilterSheet). T03 removes these when tightening downstream.

tasks.description:

Both currently take `selectedTags: string[]` and `onTagsChange: (tags: string[]) => void`. After T02, all callers pass `Tag[]` (from the hook). Tighten the prop signatures.

- `onTagsChange: (tags: string[]) => void` → `onTagsChange: (tags: Tag[]) => void`.

tasks.title: Add use-scholarship-filters tests (renderHook + Nuqs adapter)
tasks.description:
Create src/hooks/__tests__/use-scholarship-filters.test.tsx with full PRD coverage (PRD §Testing Decisions, 7 cases).

PRIOR ART (read first):
- src/hooks/__tests__/use-focus-trap.component.test.tsx — pattern for hook tests in this codebase (renderHook, component wrappers).
- Existing renderHook tests (search src/ for `renderHook`).

NUQS ADAPTER: nuqs requires a test adapter to mock URL state. Use `NuqsTestingAdapter` from `nuqs/adapters/testing` (check the installed nuqs version — currently in package.json). Wrap renderHook with the adapter: `renderHook(() => useScholarshipFilters({ scholarships: [...] }), { wrapper: ({ children }) => <NuqsTestingAdapter searchParams="?page=2&q=art">{children}</NuqsTestingAdapter> })`. If a wrapper helper makes the test bodies cleaner, define one at the top.

IMPORTS:
```ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest"
import { renderHook, act } from "@testing-library/react"
import { NuqsTestingAdapter } from "nuqs/adapters/testing"
import { useScholarshipFilters } from "../use-scholarship-filters"
import type { Scholarship } from "@/data/scholarships"
import type { Tag } from "@/lib/eligibility"
```

FIXTURE: a small Scholarship[] (4–6 items) with varied eligibilityTags and classifications — define at top of file. Add `eligibilityTags: []` to entries that don't need specific tags so the Scholarship type satisfies.

CASES (one `describe` per cluster):

1. `describe("hydration")`:
   - it("reads URL params on mount"): mount with searchParams="?page=2&q=art&sort=amount&level=Undergraduate&tags=Merit-Based,Need-Based" — expect result.current.page === 2, searchQuery === "art", sortBy === "amount", activeFilter === "Undergraduate", selectedTags === ["Merit-Based", "Need-Based"].
   - it("silently drops stale tags not in ALL_TAGS"): mount with searchParams="?tags=Need-Based,FakeOldTag" — expect selectedTags === ["Need-Based"]. (FakeOldTag is filtered out.)

2. `describe("page reset rules")`:
   - it("setActiveFilter resets page to default"): mount with ?page=3 — call act(() => result.current.setActiveFilter("Graduate")) — expect result.current.page === 1.
   - Same shape for setSearchQuery, setSortBy, setSelectedTags, setAwardRange. Bundle into `it.each` if cleaner.
   - it("setPage does NOT reset itself"): set page=2, then set page=3 — expect page === 3.
   - it("setLayout does NOT reset page"): set page=2, then call setLayout("list") — expect page === 2.

3. `describe("derived")`:
   - it("levelCounts reflects input scholarships"): pass a fixture with 2 Undergraduate + 1 Graduate; expect levelCounts.All === 3, levelCounts.Undergraduate === 2, levelCounts.Graduate === 1.
   - it("hasActiveFilters defaults to false"): fresh mount, no URL params — expect hasActiveFilters === false.
   - it("hasActiveFilters becomes true on any non-default change"): test with setSelectedTags(["Need-Based"]) → true; reset back → false; setActiveFilter("Graduate") → true; etc.

4. `describe("onFilterChangeWhileExpanded")`:
   - it("invokes the callback exactly once per filter change when provided"): mount with vi.fn() callback — call setActiveFilter, setSearchQuery, setSelectedTags — assert callback called 3 times.
   - it("does NOT invoke when callback is undefined"): mount without callback — call setActiveFilter — expect no error (covered by absence of throw).
   - it("calls callback BEFORE applying state via rAF"): use `vi.useFakeTimers()` or `act` to verify the order: callback fires synchronously, state update happens after rAF flush.

5. `describe("clearAll")`:
   - it("resets all filters to defaults"): set various non-default values, call clearAll, expect everything back to defaults.
   - it("does NOT reset layout"): setLayout("list"), then clearAll, expect layout still "list".

Total cases: ~15. Use describe blocks per cluster. ALL must pass.

DO NOT modify the hook itself or any other source file.
acceptance: Hydration: hook initialised with simulated URL ?page=2&q=art&sort=amount&level=Undergraduate&tags=Merit-Based,Need-Based exposes those values.
Page reset: setActiveFilter("Graduate") resets page to 1.
Same for setSearchQuery, setSortBy, setSelectedTags.
levelCounts reflects the input scholarships array.
hasActiveFilters is false for default state and true when any non-default value is set.
onFilterChangeWhileExpanded is invoked exactly once per filter change when provided.
Stale-tag hydration: URL with an unknown tag drops it silently.
tasks.notes: 19/19 tests pass across hydration, page-reset, derived state, callback, clearAll. File named .component.test.tsx (not .test.tsx) because vitest.config.ts gates jsdom on the .component.test.tsx suffix; renderHook needs DOM. NuqsTestingAdapter requires `hasMemory` prop for set-then-read assertions (default freezes searchParams). Callback rAF tests use `vi.spyOn(window, 'requestAnimationFrame').mockImplementation(cb => { cb(0); return 0 })` to run apply step synchronously inside act(). Orchestrator fixed react/display-name lint error by converting the wrapper from arrow factory to named function.
